_comment: Combat Tweaks chat messages. Color tokens: {default} {red} {lightblue} {yellow} {lime} {grey}. {team} is the team color of the named player. Keep every {placeholder} when translating.
rush_attempt: {rush_prefix} Player {team}{name}{default} tried to rush in a blocked zone.
barrier_locked: {rush_prefix} Rushing is blocked. It opens in {seconds} seconds, or when a team has one player left.
no_access: {admin_prefix} You don't have access to this command.
help: {admin_prefix} Commands: {lime}!ct status{default}, {lime}!ct zone{default}, {lime}!ct zone save{default}, {lime}!ct zone cancel{default}, {lime}!ct zone list{default}, {lime}!ct zone remove <number>{default}, {lime}!ct reload{default}.
must_be_alive: {admin_prefix} You must be alive to place a corner.
zone_corner1: {admin_prefix} First corner set. Walk to the opposite corner and type {lime}!ct zone{default} again.
zone_corner2: {admin_prefix} Second corner set; the box is shown. Type {lime}!ct zone save{default} to keep it or {lime}!ct zone cancel{default} to drop it.
zone_nothing: {admin_prefix} Nothing to save yet. Stand at the first corner and type {lime}!ct zone{default}.
